short_description: Printer shows 13.20 paper jam but no paper is stuck
text: If the 13.20 jam persists after the tray is clear, clear the stuck print jobs from the queue, then restart the print spooler.

short_description: Meeting room cannot join Zoom, panel frozen
text: Restart the room app first. If the panel is still frozen, reboot the codec.
Reboot the AP through the controller. If it does not come back, power-cycle the PoE port.
